name: InterContinental Paris Le Grand Hotel
insider_take: This Second Empire masterpiece sits at the cultural crossroads of Paris, where opera meets luxury in the most theatrical way possible.
whats_special: Built in 1862 for Napoleon III's grand vision of Paris, this iconic hotel faces the legendary Opéra Garnier and sits at the intersection of Paris's most famous boulevards. The building's stunning Haussmann architecture and original period details have hosted everyone from royalty to modern-day celebrities. Its prime location puts you steps from the Louvre, Place Vendôme's luxury shopping, and the vibrant café culture of the grands boulevards.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the Opéra Garnier for breathtaking views of this architectural marvel, especially stunning when illuminated at night. The hotel's concierge has exclusive connections to secure last-minute opera tickets.
dont_miss: The hotel's Café de la Paix terrace is a Parisian institution - it's been the city's premier people-watching spot since 1862. Legend says if you sit here long enough, you'll see everyone you know pass by. The original Belle Époque interiors are virtually unchanged, making every coffee feel like a step back into Paris's golden age.
pros: Prime location opposite Palais Garnier Opera House
Historic 1862 Haussmannian architecture with grand façade
Luxurious rooms with marble bathrooms and premium amenities
Multiple dining venues including Café de la Paix brasserie
cons: Busy central location with high foot traffic
